learnerFacingLabels.note: Localized learner-facing competency labels are not authored in v1. Competency IDs are never shown as interface copy. Learner-facing text in v1 is limited to objective titles and completion/mastery state copy.

families.name: Comprehension
families.scope: What the learner understood from what the other party said.

families.name: Interaction management
families.scope: How the learner runs the exchange itself.

families.name: Functional outcomes
families.scope: The real-world result the learner is trying to reach.

families.name: Language control
families.scope: Vocabulary, form, and coherence in service of meaning.

families.name: Learning strategy
families.scope: How the learner copes, repairs, and retrieves language.
